facts.fact: Sieuxerr 是宽度不足两打英里、以河流命名、全境嵌在 Rese 王国境内的小国
facts.anchor: two dozen miles across, named for its river, and enclaved within the kingdom of Rese

facts.fact: 面包店主 Emmelot 告诉 Moyna，工匠罢工将是当天上午议事会的第一项议程
facts.anchor: It’ll be first on the agenda at council this morning.

facts.fact: Moyna 在电车上回答老妇，说自己将去北方的 Camar
facts.anchor: I’ll be going to northern Camar.

facts.fact: 十年前的 serrage 是一场数月内穿过 Sieuxerr 的传染病洪流，几乎没杀死人，却使治疗师劳动力大批失能
facts.anchor: serrage was a slow-moving flood, a contagious illness that passed through Sieuxerr
